title: Disaster Management Text Sending
author: Preet Tank, Vansh Thakur, Tejas Waghmode
summary: Off-grid resilient emergency SMS transmission protocol using 433/868 MHz LoRa modules to transmit critical SOS packets when cellular towers and Wi-Fi collapse during disasters.
architecture: Hardware: ESP32 + SX1278 LoRa Transceiver. Software: C++ embedded firmware implementing CSMA/CA packet backoff, AES-128 payload encryption, and multi-hop flood routing with packet deduplication (TTL=5).

title: Mesh Network Visualization
author: Shreyas Khabale, Omkar Deshmukh
summary: Real-time interactive ad-hoc mesh networking simulator demonstrating dynamic routing path discovery, link latency variations, and automatic self-healing upon node destruction.
architecture: Interactive visual canvas using custom WebAssembly routing engine. Models node energy levels, signal degradation with distance (Friis transmission equation), and dynamic rerouting using Bellman-Ford / AODV algorithms.

title: Bluetooth Neckband Range & Stream Buffer Analyzer
author: Omkar Deshmukh
summary: Live experimental telemetry for Bluetooth neckbands and wireless headsets. Measures 2.4 GHz RF attenuation, packet drop behavior beyond the 10-meter cutoff, and stream buffer underrun persistence.
architecture: Hardware: Bluetooth 5.2 Neckband / Headset. Software: Web Audio API AudioSink routing, Log-distance path loss telemetry, and buffer underrun state machine.
